pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark brown polygonal regions with diffuse, low-contrast pixel gradients at the edges. Individual patches vary in size, with larger surface area on the mid-flank and smaller, more elongated shapes near the neck base.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-pigmented negative space. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness, widening at multi-nodal junctions and narrowing where patches are in close proximity. The network maintains high topological continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the dorsal line of the neck, characterized by short, dense hair protrusions against the sky background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark, circular nodular lesion with localized textural thickening is visible on the anatomical left shoulder/chest region, distinct from the surrounding pelage pattern.
